'''Yamamoto Hachiman Shrine''' (山本八幡宮, Yamamoto Hachimangū) is a [[shrine]] located in {{ill|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|en|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|qid=Q496072|lt=Fujinomiya|1=Fujinomiya, Shizuoka}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|en|Shizuoka Prefecture|qid=Q131320|lt=Shizuoka Prefecture|1=Shizuoka Prefecture}}. It is also referred to as '''Tōdō Hachiman Shrine''' (多田八幡宮). Under the [[Modern shrine Ranking system]], it was classified as a Village Shrine.

== Origins ==
According to tradition, the shrine was established when Yoshino Sadatomi, the great-grandfather of {{ill|Yamamoto_Kansuke_(general)|en|Yamamoto_Kansuke_(general)|qid=Q468447|lt=Yamamoto Kansuke|1=Yamamoto Kansuke (general)}}, enshrined the deity.
